stepBody: The zero-one loss is a function of both $$\beta$$ and $$T.$$ This is in contrast to the cross-entropy loss, which is only a function of $$\beta.$$ Let $$\hat{\beta}_{ZO}$$ and $$\hat{T}_{ZO}$$ be parameters that minimize the zero-one loss. Is this true about $$\hat{\beta}_{ZO}$$ and $$\hat{T}_{ZO}?$$
